an NFC key first, a KMS key delivered later: KMS goes first
KMS first, NFC later: KMS stays first
a newer KMS key goes above the older one
the user moves NFC above KMS
after the move, a new KMS key goes above the old KMS key but stays below NFC
after the move, a new hw_only key also stays below NFC
hw_only keys go above shared KMS keys
a shared KMS key with only hw_only keys present goes right below them
without KMS, other keys keep their arrival order
a first KMS key goes to the top when no KMS key exists
the user moves the KMS key down below NFC
moving the first key up or the last key down changes nothing
deleting the top KMS key: the next KMS key does not jump over NFC
NFC placed by hand above KMS; after deleting every KMS key a new KMS key still goes below NFC
nothing placed by hand: after deleting every KMS key a new KMS key goes to the top
only the moved key is placed: a new KMS key goes above the first key not placed by hand
deleting a placed key clears its mark
a pairing with another device of the same person is a new key at the end
a longer mixed sequence
store: the new key takes the earlier key's place below KMS, the earlier key goes directly below it
store: the new key takes the place above KMS, the earlier key goes directly below it
store moves the mark: a new KMS key then goes below the new key but above the unmarked earlier key
finalize deletes the earlier key: the new key keeps the place and mark
finalize with the default place below KMS
finalizing twice changes nothing
finalizing a key never deletes a key of the same device stored after it
finalizing the newest key deletes every older key of the device
finalizing touches only the keys of that device
the user deletes a stored key that never finalized: the earlier key stays
the user deletes the retiring key, then the new key finalizes

NFC v2, FINALIZE of ceremony 1 lost, confirmation of ceremony 2 lost, a call, a re-tap answered 03, reader
same, card: the call finalizes O2 and deletes only O1, the ceremony-2 key O3 stays
Android to Android: a phone holding a waiting key from an earlier ceremony as card is now the reader and finalizes the new key
